title: The Rings of Power
subtitle: The Second Age of Middle-earth
description: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power (Prime Video). Events and journeys of the series, episode by episode.

episodes.title: A Shadow of the Past
episodes.synopsis: Galadriel hunts for Sauron in the frozen north. Harfoots, Southlanders and Elves each sense the long peace ending — and a stranger falls from the sky.

episodes.title: Adrift
episodes.synopsis: Galadriel meets a castaway on the Sundering Seas, Elrond visits Khazad-dûm, and Orcs come up through the floors of the Southlands.

episodes.title: Adar
episodes.synopsis: Galadriel and Halbrand reach Númenor, Arondir is enslaved in the trenches of the Orcs, and the Harfoots discover the Stranger.

episodes.title: The Great Wave
episodes.synopsis: Míriel reveals her vision of Númenor's fall, Adar sends his ultimatum, and Elrond learns the secret of the Dwarves.

episodes.title: Partings
episodes.synopsis: The Southlanders must choose a side, Númenor sets sail, and Gil-galad reveals why the Elves need mithril.

episodes.title: Udûn
episodes.synopsis: Adar attacks the Southlands. Númenor arrives in time to win the battle — but not to stop what the Orcs were really digging for.

episodes.title: The Eye
episodes.synopsis: Survivors stumble through the ash, the Harfoots meet the Stranger's hunters, and King Durin shuts the mithril mine, waking something below.

episodes.title: Alloyed
episodes.synopsis: The Stranger learns what he is, Halbrand is unmasked, and three rings are forged in Eregion.

episodes.title: Elven Kings Under the Sky
episodes.synopsis: How Sauron fell and returned. The Elves decide what to do with their rings; the Stranger and Nori reach Rhûn.

episodes.title: Where the Stars are Strange
episodes.synopsis: Khazad-dûm goes dark, a Dark Wizard hunts the Stranger, and a 'Lord of Gifts' comes to Celebrimbor.

episodes.title: The Eagle and the Sceptre
episodes.synopsis: Isildur fights his way out of Mordor, Númenor's coronation is upended by an eagle, and the Dwarves are offered rings.

episodes.title: Eldest
episodes.synopsis: Elrond's company takes the dangerous road. The Stranger meets Tom Bombadil, Nori meets the Stoors, and Arondir meets the Ents.

episodes.title: Halls of Stone
episodes.synopsis: The Dwarven ring works too well, Annatar pushes for rings for Men, and blood is spilled in Númenor.

episodes.title: Where Is He?
episodes.synopsis: Adar offers Galadriel an alliance, Míriel faces the sea-worm, and the siege of Eregion begins.

episodes.title: Doomed to Die
episodes.synopsis: The battle for Eregion. Celebrimbor sees through the illusion and finishes the Nine.

episodes.title: Shadow and Flame
episodes.synopsis: A Balrog, a wizard's name, a fallen city — and Sauron takes his rings and his army.
